question.sl: Ali lahko psi zaužijejo sojino omako?

answer.en: No, don't give your dog soy sauce. Dogs can get salt poisoning from eating too much table salt or soy sauce, and edamame seasoned with soy sauce isn't good for dogs either.
answer.sl: Ne, psu ne dajajte sojine omake. Psi se lahko zastrupijo s soljo, če pojedo preveč kuhinjske soli ali sojine omake, tudi edamame, začinjen s sojino omako, pa za pse ni dober.

why.en: Dogs can suffer from salt poisoning if they eat excess amounts of table salt or soy sauce. Dogs cope with salt better when they can drink plenty of fresh water; without it the risk is higher. Too many salty foods are especially bad for dogs with medical issues such as heart disease, because salt can cause fluid retention.
why.sl: Psi se lahko zastrupijo s soljo, če pojedo preveč kuhinjske soli ali sojine omake. S soljo se psi lažje spopadejo, če lahko pijejo veliko sveže vode; brez nje je tveganje večje. Preveč slane hrane še posebej škodi psom z zdravstvenimi težavami, kot je bolezen srca, ker sol lahko povzroči zastajanje tekočine.

what_to_do.en: If you think your dog has had too much soy sauce, contact your vet or a pet poison line immediately. Make sure your dog has fresh water to drink.
what_to_do.sl: Če sumite, da je pes zaužil preveč sojine omake, takoj pokličite veterinarja ali center za zastrupitve živali. Poskrbite, da ima pes na voljo svežo vodo.

child.en: Soy sauce is not for dogs. Too much of it can make a dog sick, so give your dog dog food and fresh water instead.
child.sl: Sojina omaka ni za pse. Če je pes poje preveč, mu lahko slabo dene, zato mu raje daj pasjo hrano in svežo vodo.

q.en: Can my dog eat edamame with soy sauce?
q.sl: Ali lahko pes je edamame s sojino omako?

a.en: No. Stay away from edamame with added seasonings such as sea salt and soy sauce, as these aren't good for dogs. Stick to plain, fresh beans.
a.sl: Ne. Izogibajte se edamamu z dodanimi začimbami, kot sta morska sol in sojina omaka, saj za pse nista dobri. Dajajte le navaden, svež edamame.

Be aware of the following signs your dog may have consumed too much salt:
Vomiting
Diarrhea
Decreased appetite
Lethargy
Lack of coordination or being wobbly on their feet
Excessive thirst or urination
Tremors or seizures
If you suspect your dog has consumed too much salt, contact a veterinarian or the Pet Poison Helpline immediately.
Always stay away from edamame beans with added seasonings, such as sea salt and soy sauce as these aren't good for dogs.
Stick to plain, fresh edamame beans and avoid processed ones as these tend to have added salt and other additives.
